═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
CORE FEATURES
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

1. Test Generation (TestGenerator)
   - AST-based function extraction
   - AAA test pattern scaffolding
   - Coverage gap detection
   - Automatic file creation

2. Sandbox Execution (SandboxExecutor)
   - Isolated command execution
   - Timeout management
   - Command validation
   - Parallel execution support

3. Coverage Validation (CoverageValidator)
   - Baseline comparison
   - Delta computation
   - Gap identification
   - Module-level analysis

4. Artifact Reporting (ArtifactReporter)
   - JSON report generation
   - Markdown summaries
   - Multi-format support
   - GitHub integration ready

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
USAGE EXAMPLES
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Generate tests
python cli.py --manifest manifest.yaml \
  --task '{"type": "generate_tests", "module": "mymodule"}'

# Validate coverage
python cli.py --manifest manifest.yaml \
  --task '{"type": "validate_coverage", "threshold": 85}'

# Execute tests
python cli.py --manifest manifest.yaml \
  --task '{"type": "execute_tests", "command": "pytest"}'

# Debug CI failure
python cli.py --manifest manifest.yaml \
  --task '{"type": "debug_ci_failure", "command": "pytest"}'
